changes_vs_current: Chick-fil-A stays #1. In-N-Out (was #1) falls out of the top 24 (only Ranker, at 10) and Whataburger, Raising Cane's, Shake Shack, Wingstop, Jersey Mike's, Jack in the Box, Del Taco and Carl's Jr. also fall out. Wendy's, Taco Bell, Dunkin', Subway, Burger King move up. New entrants: Domino's, Panera, Pizza Hut, Starbucks, Papa John's, Little Caesars, Baskin-Robbins, Cinnabon. Baskin-Robbins and Cinnabon (22-23) are dessert shops, each in one source only. Swap them for A&W (22.0), Jack in the Box (22.2) or Jersey Mike's (22.2) if you want savory fast food only.
confidence: medium-low. Four independent methods (popularity poll, sales, satisfaction, fan vote), but they measure different things: YouGov favors ice cream and pizza, QSR favors size, ACSI favors satisfaction. Parts of the QSR (11-23) and ACSI (6-24) rankings are from search extracts, not fetched pages. Regional chains (In-N-Out, Whataburger, Culver's) are structurally penalized by national samples. I did not use the Five Guys vs In-N-Out burger poll because it only ranks burgers.
